title: Chicago Fed&\#x27;s Goolsbee Says Fed Has &\#x27;Work to Do&\#x27; on Inflation
summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Federal Reserve "has definitely got work to do" to restore credibility on inflation, after the producer price index rose 6.5% over the year to October, its highest annual gain since November 2022. Markets were fully pricing a quarter-point rate increase at the Fed&\#x27;s Dec. 8-9 meeting, according to CME Group&\#x27;s FedWatch.
